responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend helper for interpreting Rust source filenames as potential owners of module subdirectories. The header exposes get_file_subdir, which reports whether a filename corresponds to a non-root *.rs module file and, if so, returns the derived subdirectory name used by module-loading code to apply Rust’s mod.rs versus foo.rs directory ownership convention.
same_name_distinction: Header half of the rust-dir-owner pair: it only declares get_file_subdir for other module-loading code to call, while rust-dir-owner.cc provides the actual filename tests for mod.rs/lib.rs/main.rs and the derived subdirectory computation.
